_comment: PubMed seed queries for PaperFate corpus. Balanced across 22 specialties + 8 methodologies. Each entry × each year bucket → saved to data/pubmed/<key>-<yearLow>-<yearHigh>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl. Tune freely. Run `npm run collect <key1> <key2>` to do a subset.

seeds.oncology_solid: (non-small cell lung cancer[Title/Abstract] OR breast cancer[Title/Abstract] OR colorectal cancer[Title/Abstract] OR melanoma[Title/Abstract]) AND (treatment[Title/Abstract] OR therapy[Title/Abstract] OR outcomes[Title/Abstract])
seeds.oncology_immuno: (immune checkpoint inhibitor[Title/Abstract] OR pembrolizumab[Title/Abstract] OR nivolumab[Title/Abstract] OR CAR-T[Title/Abstract]) AND (clinical trial[Publication Type] OR cohort[Title/Abstract])
seeds.cardiology_hf: (heart failure[Title/Abstract] OR cardiomyopathy[Title/Abstract] OR ejection fraction[Title/Abstract]) AND (treatment[Title/Abstract] OR prognosis[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])
seeds.cardiology_cad: (coronary artery disease[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR PCI[Title/Abstract] OR statin[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.neurology_stroke: (stroke[Title/Abstract] OR cerebral infarction[Title/Abstract] OR thrombectomy[Title/Abstract]) AND (outcome[Title/Abstract] OR treatment[Title/Abstract] OR risk[Title/Abstract])
seeds.neurology_dementia: (Alzheimer[Title/Abstract] OR dementia[Title/Abstract] OR cognitive decline[Title/Abstract] OR lecanemab[Title/Abstract])
seeds.endocrine_diabetes: (type 2 diabetes[Title/Abstract] OR HbA1c[Title/Abstract] OR insulin resistance[Title/Abstract]) AND (treatment[Title/Abstract] OR outcomes[Title/Abstract])
seeds.endocrine_glp1: (GLP-1[Title/Abstract] OR semaglutide[Title/Abstract] OR tirzepatide[Title/Abstract] OR liraglutide[Title/Abstract]) AND (obesity[Title/Abstract] OR diabetes[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract])
seeds.pulmonology: (COPD[Title/Abstract] OR asthma[Title/Abstract] OR pulmonary[Title/Abstract] OR respiratory failure[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.nephrology_ckd: (chronic kidney disease[Title/Abstract] OR CKD[Title/Abstract] OR dialysis[Title/Abstract] OR eGFR[Title/Abstract])
seeds.infection_general: (sepsis[Title/Abstract] OR antibiotic resistance[Title/Abstract] OR HIV[Title/Abstract] OR tuberculosis[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.infection_vaccine: (vaccine[Title/Abstract] OR vaccination[Title/Abstract] OR immunization[Title/Abstract]) AND (efficacy[Title/Abstract] OR effectiveness[Title/Abstract] OR safety[Title/Abstract])
seeds.gastro_ibd: (inflammatory bowel disease[Title/Abstract] OR Crohn[Title/Abstract] OR ulcerative colitis[Title/Abstract] OR IBD[Title/Abstract])
seeds.hepatology_general: (chronic hepatitis B[Title/Abstract] OR NAFLD[Title/Abstract] OR MASLD[Title/Abstract] OR cirrhosis[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.hepatology_hcc: (hepatocellular carcinoma[Title/Abstract] OR HCC[Title/Abstract]) AND (risk[Title/Abstract] OR surveillance[Title/Abstract] OR prediction[Title/Abstract])
seeds.rheumatology: (rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract] OR systemic lupus[Title/Abstract] OR psoriatic arthritis[Title/Abstract] OR autoimmune[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.psychiatry: (major depressive disorder[Title/Abstract] OR schizophrenia[Title/Abstract] OR bipolar[Title/Abstract] OR anxiety disorder[Title/Abstract])
seeds.surgery: (laparoscopic[Title/Abstract] OR robotic surgery[Title/Abstract] OR perioperative[Title/Abstract] OR enhanced recovery[Title/Abstract]) AND outcomes[Title/Abstract]
seeds.pediatrics: (pediatric[Title/Abstract] OR paediatric[Title/Abstract] OR neonatal[Title/Abstract] OR adolescent[Title/Abstract]) AND (outcome[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract])
seeds.obgyn: (pregnancy[Title/Abstract] OR preeclampsia[Title/Abstract] OR ovarian cancer[Title/Abstract] OR endometriosis[Title/Abstract])
seeds.critical_care: (intensive care unit[Title/Abstract] OR ICU[Title/Abstract] OR mechanical ventilation[Title/Abstract] OR ARDS[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.public_health_epi: (population-based[Title/Abstract] OR national registry[Title/Abstract] OR cohort study[Title/Abstract]) AND (incidence[Title/Abstract] OR risk factor[Title/Abstract] OR epidemiology[Title/Abstract])
seeds.method_rct_landmark: (randomized controlled trial[Publication Type]) AND (Lancet[Journal] OR "N Engl J Med"[Journal] OR JAMA[Journal] OR BMJ[Journal] OR "Ann Intern Med"[Journal])
seeds.method_meta_analysis: (meta-analysis[Publication Type]) AND (therapy[Title/Abstract] OR treatment[Title/Abstract] OR intervention[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.method_ai_clinical: (deep learning[Title/Abstract] OR machine learning[Title/Abstract] OR transformer[Title/Abstract] OR foundation model[Title/Abstract]) AND (clinical[Title/Abstract] OR diagnosis[Title/Abstract] OR prognosis[Title/Abstract] OR risk prediction[Title/Abstract])
seeds.method_imaging_ai: (MRI[Title/Abstract] OR CT[Title/Abstract] OR ultrasound[Title/Abstract] OR radiomics[Title/Abstract]) AND (deep learning[Title/Abstract] OR AI[Title/Abstract] OR neural network[Title/Abstract])
seeds.method_external_valid: (external validation[Title/Abstract] OR multicenter[Title/Abstract] OR multi-center[Title/Abstract]) AND (prediction model[Title/Abstract] OR risk score[Title/Abstract] OR clinical model[Title/Abstract])
seeds.method_decision_curve: (decision curve analysis[Title/Abstract] OR net benefit[Title/Abstract] OR clinical utility[Title/Abstract])
seeds.method_biomarker: (biomarker[Title/Abstract] OR prognostic marker[Title/Abstract]) AND (validation[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract])
seeds.method_precision_med: (precision medicine[Title/Abstract] OR personalized medicine[Title/Abstract] OR genomic[Title/Abstract] OR polygenic[Title/Abstract])
